members.name: heapify
members.doc: Transform list into a heap, in-place, in O(len(heap)) time.

members.name: heappop
members.doc: Pop the smallest item off the heap, maintaining the heap invariant.

members.name: heappush
members.doc: Push item onto heap, maintaining the heap invariant.

members.name: heappushpop
members.doc: Push item on the heap, then pop and return the smallest item from the heap. The combined action runs more efficiently than heappush() followed by a separate cal

members.name: heapreplace
members.doc: Pop and return the current smallest value, and add the new item. This is more efficient than heappop() followed by heappush(), and can be more appropriate when

members.name: merge
members.doc: Merge multiple sorted inputs into a single sorted output. Similar to sorted(itertools.chain(*iterables)) but returns a generator, does not pull the data into me

members.name: nlargest
members.doc: Find the n largest elements in a dataset. Equivalent to: sorted(iterable, key=key, reverse=True)[:n]

members.name: nsmallest
members.doc: Find the n smallest elements in a dataset. Equivalent to: sorted(iterable, key=key)[:n]
